text:
Alex Kim: CI on main is red for golden-tests/serial-output. Failing diff looks like a small serialization change in the prompt renderer. Can someone triage?
ci-bot: [build #4821] FAILED - test: //tests/golden:serial_output (see https://ci.redwood.example/build/4821)
Maya Patel: on it. Which commit SHA?
Alex Kim: looks like 9f3b2c7 -> merged yesterday from PR #3248 (serializer newline normalization).
Samir Desai: if that's the PR, probably whitespace/escape change. Quick bisect: run `git bisect start HEAD 9f3b2c7 -- tests/golden/serial_output` or just rerun the CI job locally with `./dev/ci_rerun.sh tests/golden/serial_output`.
Maya Patel: running local rerun now. giving me a minute.
Lisa G: fyi the PR touched the tokenizer->serializer boundary, added `.strip()` in one path. Might explain trimming at end-of-line.
Maya Patel: rerun done: same diff. snippet: `- prompt: "Hello\n"
+ prompt: "Hello"` — trailing newline removed. Not sure if golden should be updated or serializer reverted.
Samir Desai: thanks. Can you run `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-k serial_output -q' tox -e py` locally and paste the minimal failing assertion? Also pls run with `REDWOOD_LOG=serializer:debug` to capture serialization code paths.
Maya Patel: running that next. quick note: this is flaky historically; sometimes CI picks up an extra \n from prompt builder.
Jordan Parks: hold release 1.12.0 rollout? We have canary at 4% but probably fine to pause until we decide.
Alex Kim: put release on hold for now. If it's just newline trimming we can revert PR or update golden. Need decision from Samir after debug logs.
Maya Patel: debug logs: serializer normalized trailing whitespace at end_of_prompt in one branch. I can reproduce locally by running: `python -m scripts.render_prompt --sample "Hello\n"` -> output shows trimmed.
Samir Desai: ok looks intentional but surfaced in goldens. Two options: 1) update golden snapshots to match new normalized output (if change is benign), 2) revert normalization for now and open an RFC to discuss. My recommendation: update goldens for this test only, run full snapshot smoke check, then schedule RFC.
Lisa G: if we update goldens, please ensure we add a changelog note. Also run downstream evals for a quick quality check.
Maya Patel: updating goldens locally and running smoke: `./dev/goldens/update tests/golden/serial_output && ./dev/goldens/smoke-check` -> smoke-check passed locally.
Alex Kim: Sweet. Maya, can you push a follow-up PR with golden update and include CI run. Samir, can you open the RFC issue and assign to serializer owners?
Samir Desai: will open ISSUE-421 with details and assign.
Maya Patel: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3301 — includes golden update and test notes. CI triggered.
ci-bot: [build #4823] RUNNING - triggered by Maya Patel (PR 3301)
Jordan Parks: thanks all — holding main rollout until #3301 lands. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: thanks team, great async triage.
Lisa G: :thumbsup:
